facts.fact: Brooks 和 Everett 难得休班，日出骑马后信步走到 Hart 家。
facts.anchor: We both have a rare day off, and after taking Periwinkle and Della out for a long ride at sunrise, we’ve walked aimlessly around the ranch and found ourselves at the Hart property.

facts.fact: 祖父赠给 Brooks 父母约三英亩的地建房安家。
facts.anchor: Grandaddy Smith gifted them a parcel of land. It’s not huge, not compared to the vast amount of land the family owns, but it’s a good three and a bit acres, and they built themselves a home.

facts.fact: Dean 为自创的 Tri-town Pups 训练明年三月的 Texas 10K。
facts.anchor: He’s running the Texas 10K in March in aid of the Tri-town Pups, a dog rescue he set up a few years ago.

facts.fact: 去年夏天蜜蜂蜇了 Emmy 脚踝，众人才知她蜂毒过敏。
facts.anchor: We found out the hard way about Emmy’s bee sting allergy last summer, when a bee got into the Tanners’ kitchen and stung her ankle.

facts.fact: Harriet 来电说 Bunny 丢了，Brooks 发群消息召集搜索队。

facts.fact: Bunny 是 Harriet 宣布怀孕次日他在 Farrow 买的。
facts.anchor: I bought Bunny for Emmy the day after Harriet and Dean broke the news that she was pregnant.

facts.fact: Ashton 分派搜索任务：Solly 搜 Harriet 家一带，她与 Big John 分搜灌木丛与草甸。
facts.anchor: Okay. Solly, take the patch around Harriet and Dean’s house up to the thicket. Big John, you and I will split the thicket and the meadow.

facts.fact: Ruth 因合同审查视频会议未能参加找 Bunny。
facts.anchor: Working. Got a video meeting about some contract review or advice or something, I don’t know.
